Ollama provider sends the embedding to /api/embed and maps the native reply

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	req := pkg.EmbeddingRequest{
		Model: `ollama/all-minilm`,
		Input: pkg.EmbeddingInput(`["Hello","World"]`),
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Embed(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Data)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Model)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Usage.PromptTokens)
}
```
